REPLACE:movement_cultural_majority = {
	category = movement_category_cultural_majority

	ideology = ideology_ethno_nationalist_movement
	character_ideologies = {
		ideology_ethno_nationalist
	}

	can_cause_obstinance = yes

	creation_trigger = {
		NOT = { has_game_rule = vl_one_culture } # Victoria 3 Lite

		# Will not spawn if you're an un-unified German, Italian, or Yugoslav state
		NOR = {
			country_has_german_national_movement = yes
			country_has_italian_national_movement = yes
			country_has_yugoslav_national_movement = yes
		}
	}

	creation_weight = {
		value = 100
	}
	on_created = {}

	disband_trigger = {
		OR = {
			has_game_rule = vl_one_culture # Victoria 3 Lite
			AND = {
		OR = {
			country_has_german_national_movement = yes
			country_has_italian_national_movement = yes
			country_has_yugoslav_national_movement = yes
		}
				}
		}
	}

	character_support_trigger = {
		culture = {
			is_primary_culture_of = root.owner
		}
		OR = {
			has_ideology = ideology:ideology_fascist
			has_ideology = ideology:ideology_jingoist_leader
			has_ideology = ideology:ideology_ethno_nationalist
		}
		NOT = {
			has_variable = anti_nationalist_var
		}
	}
	character_support_weight = {
		value = 100
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_ideology = ideology:ideology_ethno_nationalist
			}
			multiply = {
				value = 5
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_fascist
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_jingoist_leader
				}
			}
			multiply = {
				value = 2
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					has_progressive_ideology = yes
					has_socialist_ideology = yes
				}
			}
			multiply = 0.05
		}
	}

	pop_support_trigger = {
		culture = {
			is_primary_culture_of = root.owner
		}
	}

	pop_support_factors = {
		movement_support_national_awakening
		movement_support_cultural_fervor
		movement_support_shopkeepers
		movement_support_officers
		movement_support_farmers
		movement_support_clerks
		movement_support_soldiers
		movement_support_peasants
		movement_support_colonial_settlers
		movement_support_nationalism_tech
		movement_support_pan_nationalism_tech
	}

	pop_support_weight = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:political_movement
				scope:political_movement ?= {
					OR = {
						is_being_suppressed = yes
						is_being_bolstered = yes
					}
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					scope:political_movement = {
						is_being_suppressed = yes
					}
				}
				add = {
					value = suppression_base_value
					multiply = {
						value = -0.5
						add = owner.modifier:country_suppression_attraction_factor
					}
					desc = "concept_suppressed"
				}
			}
			else = {
				add = {
					value = bolstering_base_value
					multiply = {
						value = 0.5
						add = owner.modifier:country_bolster_attraction_factor
					}
					desc = "concept_bolstered"
				}
			}
		}

		if = {
			limit = {
				strata = upper
			}
			add = {
				value = 10
				desc = "UPPER_NO_ICON"
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				strata = middle
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					is_pop_type = shopkeepers
				}
				add = {
					value = 25
					desc = "POP_SHOPKEEPERS"
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					is_pop_type = officers
				}
				add = {
					value = 20
					desc = "POP_OFFICERS"
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					is_pop_type = farmers
				}
				add = {
					value = 15
					desc = "POP_FARMERS"
				}
			}
			else = {
				add = {
					value = 12
					desc = "MIDDLE_NO_ICON"
				}
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				strata = lower
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					is_pop_type = clerks
				}
				add = {
					value = 25
					desc = "POP_CLERKS"
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					is_pop_type = soldiers
				}
				add = {
					value = 20
					desc = "POP_SOLDIERS"
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					is_pop_type = peasants
				}
				add = {
					value = 10
					desc = "POP_PEASANTS"
				}
			}
			else = {
				add = {
					value = 5
					desc = "LOWER_NO_ICON"
				}
			}
		}

		if = {
			limit = {
				state = {
					is_incorporated = no
				}
			}
			multiply = {
				value = 1.5
				desc = "COLONIAL_SETTLERS"
			}
		}

		if = {
			limit = {
				owner ?= {
					has_technology_researched = pan-nationalism
				}
			}
			multiply = {
				value = 1.5
				desc = "PAN_NATIONALISM_TECH"
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				owner ?= {
					has_technology_researched = nationalism
				}
			}
			multiply = {
				value = 1.25
				desc = "NATIONALISM_TECH"
			}
		}

		multiply = { # Range from x0.775 to 2.275
			desc = "POP_CULTURE_FERVOR"
			value = culture.culture_current_fervor
			subtract = 15
			multiply = 0.015
			add = 1
		}

		if = {
			limit = {
				culture ?= {
					culture_has_national_awakening = yes
				}
			}
			multiply = {
				value = 1.5
				desc = "POP_ACTIVE_NATIONAL_AWAKENING"
			}
		}

		if = { # If a more radical movement exists, it'll poach radicals from this one.
			limit = {
				owner ?= {
					any_political_movement = {
						OR = {
							is_political_movement_type = movement_reactionary
							is_political_movement_type = movement_fascist
						}
					}
				}
			}
			multiply = {
				desc = "POP_RADICAL_MOVEMENT_LOSSES"
				value = 1
				subtract = pop_radical_fraction
			}
		}

		if = {
			limit = {
				owner ?= {
					any_political_movement = {
						is_political_movement_type = movement_anti_communist
					}
				}
			}
			multiply = {
				value = 0.5
				desc = "POP_ANTI_COMMUNIST_MOVEMENT_LOSSES"
			}
		}
	}

	revolution = {
		possible = {
			political_movement_support >= 0.05
		}

		weight = {
			value = 100
		}

		state_weight = {
			value = 1

			if = {
				limit = {
					is_capital = no
					is_homeland_of_country_cultures = owner
					primary_cultures_percent_state = {
						target_country = owner
						value >= 0.05
					}
				}
				add = 10

				if = {
					limit = {
						primary_cultures_percent_state = {
							target_country = owner
							value >= 0.75
						}
					}
					add = 1000
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = {
						primary_cultures_percent_state = {
							target_country = owner
							value >= 0.5
						}
					}
					add = 500
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = {
						primary_cultures_percent_state = {
							target_country = owner
							value >= 0.25
						}
					}
					add = 100
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = {
						primary_cultures_percent_state = {
							target_country = owner
							value >= 0.1
						}
					}
					add = 50
				}
			}
		}
	}

	secession = {
		possible = {
			political_movement_support >= 0.05
			scope:clout <= 0
		}

		weight = {
			value = 1000
		}

		state_weight = {
			value = 0

			if = {
				limit = {
					is_capital = no
					is_homeland_of_country_cultures = owner
					primary_cultures_percent_state = {
						target_country = owner
						value >= 0.05
					}
				}
				add = { # These three values must add up to more than 1 - 5 x Obstinance, 1/2 Turmoil, percent of pops of primary cultures
					value = -1
					add = "this.primary_cultures_percent_state(owner)"
					add = {
						value = this.turmoil
						multiply = 0.5
					}
					add = {
						value = this.obstinance
						multiply = 5
				}
					multiply = 100
				}
			}
		}
	}

	additional_radicalism_factors = {
		add = movement_radicalism_ruler_not_primary_culture

		add = {
			value = "owner.average_sol"
			subtract = "owner.average_sol_for_primary_cultures"
			multiply = 0.05
			max = 0.5
			min = 0
			desc = "STANDARD_OF_LIVING_FOR_PRIMARY_CULTURES"
		}

		if = {
			limit = {
				owner ?= {
					has_technology_researched = nationalism
					any_scope_homeland_state = {
						NOT = {
							this.owner ?= {
								any_primary_culture = {
									is_primary_culture_of = root.owner
								}
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				owner ?= {
					every_scope_homeland_state = {
						limit = {
							NOT = {
								this.owner ?= {
									any_primary_culture = {
										is_primary_culture_of = root.owner
									}
								}
							}
						}
						add = 0.025
					}
				}
				max = 0.25
				desc = "MOVEMENT_RADICALISM_UNOWNED_HOMELAND_STATES_FACTOR"
			}
		}

		if = {
			limit = {
				any_in_global_list = { # Victoria 3 Lite: only countries with an insurrection (list refreshed monthly), not every neighbouring state
					variable = vl_insurgent_countries
					is_adjacent_to_country = ROOT.owner
					AND = { AND = {
							NOT = { THIS = ROOT.owner }
							any_political_movement = {
								OR = {
									AND = {
										is_political_movement_type = movement_cultural_majority
										prev = {
											any_primary_culture = {
												is_primary_culture_of = root.owner
											}
										}
									}
									AND = {
										is_political_movement_type = movement_cultural_minority
										culture ?= { is_primary_culture_of = root.owner }
									}
								}
								is_insurrectionary = yes
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				desc = "NEIGHBOURING_COUNTRY_WITH_CULTURE_REVOLUTION"
				value = 0.15
			}
		}

		add = movement_radicalism_suppressed_after_civil_war
	}
}

REPLACE:movement_cultural_minority = {
	category = movement_category_cultural

	ideology = ideology_pluralist_movement_1
	character_ideologies = {
		ideology_reformer
	}

	can_cause_obstinance = yes

	creation_trigger = {}
	creation_weight = {
		value = 100
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner ?= {
					has_technology_researched = nationalism
				}
			}
			multiply = {
				value = 2
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner ?= {
					has_variable = failed_tanzimat
				}
			}
			multiply = {
				value = 2
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner ?= {
					has_journal_entry = je_springtime_of_the_peoples
				}
			}
			multiply = {
				value = 2
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner ?= {
					has_journal_entry = je_great_eastern_crisis
				}
			}
			multiply = {
				value = 2
			}
		}
	}
	on_created = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				culture = {
					AND = {
						shares_heritage_trait_with_any_primary_culture = root.owner
						OR = {
							shares_language_trait_group_with_any_primary_culture = root.owner
							shares_tradition_trait_with_any_primary_culture = root.owner
						}
					}
				}
			}
			set_core_ideology = ideology_pluralist_movement_1
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				culture = {
					shares_heritage_trait_group_with_any_primary_culture = root.owner
					OR = {
						shares_language_trait_group_with_any_primary_culture = root.owner
						shares_tradition_trait_with_any_primary_culture = root.owner
					}
				}
			}
			set_core_ideology = ideology_pluralist_movement_2
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				culture = {
					OR = {
						shares_heritage_trait_group_with_any_primary_culture = root.owner
						shares_language_trait_with_any_primary_culture = root.owner
					}
				}
			}
			set_core_ideology = ideology_pluralist_movement_3
		}
		else = {
			set_core_ideology = ideology_pluralist_movement_4
		}
	}

	disband_trigger = {
		scope:political_movement ?= {
			OR = {
				culture = {
					is_primary_culture_of = root
				}
				root = {
					AND = {
						NOT = {
							any_scope_state = {
								state_region = {
									is_homeland = scope:political_movement.culture
								}
								culture_percent_state = {
									target = scope:political_movement.culture
									value >= 0.18
								}
							}
						}
						OR = {
							culture_percent_country = {
								target = scope:political_movement.culture
								value <= 0.08
							}
							cultural_acceptance_base = { target = scope:political_movement.culture value > acceptance_status_2 }
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	culture_selection_trigger = {
		NOT = { is_primary_culture_of = scope:country }
		OR = {
			culture_current_fervor >= 10
			scope:country = {
				any_scope_diplomatic_pact = {
					is_diplomatic_action_type = support_separatism
					second_country = prev
					"diplomatic_pact_other_country(scope:country)" = {
						country_has_primary_culture = root
					}
				}
			}
		}
		scope:country = {
			OR = {
				any_scope_state = {
					state_region = {
						is_homeland = root
					}
					culture_percent_state = {
						target = root
						value >= 0.2
					}
				}
				AND = {
					culture_percent_country = {
						target = root
						value >= 0.1
					}
					cultural_acceptance_base = { target = root value <= acceptance_status_2 }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	culture_selection_weight = {
		value = 100

		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:country = {
					any_scope_diplomatic_pact = {
						is_diplomatic_action_type = support_separatism
						second_country = prev
						"diplomatic_pact_other_country(scope:country)" = {
							country_has_primary_culture = root
						}
					}
				}
			}
			multiply = 3
		}
	}

	character_support_trigger = {
		OR = {
			culture = scope:culture
			has_ideology = ideology:ideology_humanitarian
			has_ideology = ideology:ideology_humanitarian_royalist
			has_ideology = ideology:ideology_sovereignist_leader
			has_ideology = ideology:ideology_reformer
		}
		NOT = {
			has_variable = anti_nationalist_var # Please stop becoming a Polish nationalist, Rosa.
		}
	}
	character_support_weight = {
		value = 50
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_ideology = ideology:ideology_sovereignist_leader
			}
			multiply = {
				value = 10
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_humanitarian_royalist
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_humanitarian
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_reformer
				}
			}
			multiply = {
				value = 5
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				has_socialist_ideology = yes
			}
			multiply = {
				value = 0.5
			}
		}
	}

	pop_support_trigger = {
		culture = scope:culture
	}

	pop_support_factors = {
		movement_support_national_awakening
		movement_support_cultural_fervor
		movement_support_cultural_discrimination
		movement_support_je_sick_man_main
		movement_support_je_matter_of_hungary
		movement_support_aristocrats_polish
		movement_support_academics
		movement_support_clergymen
		movement_support_clerks
		movement_support_soldiers
		movement_support_nationalism_tech
		movement_support_pan_nationalism_tech
		movement_support_support_separatism_action
	}

	pop_support_weight = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:political_movement
				scope:political_movement ?= {
					OR = {
						is_being_suppressed = yes
						is_being_bolstered = yes
					}
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					scope:political_movement = {
						is_being_suppressed = yes
					}
				}
				add = {
					value = suppression_base_value
					multiply = {
						value = -0.5
						add = owner.modifier:country_suppression_attraction_factor
					}
					desc = "concept_suppressed"
				}
			}
			else = {
				add = {
					value = bolstering_base_value
					multiply = {
						value = 0.5
						add = owner.modifier:country_bolster_attraction_factor
					}
					desc = "concept_bolstered"
				}
			}
		}

		if = {
			limit = {
				strata = upper
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					is_pop_type = aristocrats
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						culture = cu:polish
						state ?= {
							OR = {
								has_variable = lingering_plc_resistance
								has_variable = christ_of_nations_target
							}
						}
					}
					add = {
						value = 50
						desc = "POP_POLISH_ARISTOCRATS"
					}
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = {
						culture = cu:hungarian
						owner ?= {
							has_journal_entry = je_matter_of_hungary
						}
					}
					add = {
						value = 50
						desc = "je_matter_of_hungary"
					}
				}
				else = {
					add = {
						value = 12
						desc = "POP_ARISTOCRATS"
					}
				}
			}
			else = {
				add = {
					value = 18
					desc = "UPPER_NO_ICON"
				}
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				strata = middle
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					is_pop_type = academics
				}
				add = {
					value = 40
					desc = "POP_ACADEMICS"
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					is_pop_type = clergymen
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						NOT = {
							this.religion = owner.religion
						}
					}
					add = {
						value = 40
						desc = "POP_CLERGYMEN"
					}
				}
				else = {
					add = {
						value = 15
						desc = "POP_CLERGYMEN"
					}
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					is_pop_type = shopkeepers
				}
				add = {
					value = 25
					desc = "POP_SHOPKEEPERS"
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					is_pop_type = soldiers
				}
				add = {
					value = 20
					desc = "POP_OFFICERS"
				}
			}
			else = {
				add = {
					value = 15
					desc = "MIDDLE_NO_ICON"
				}
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				strata = lower
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					is_pop_type = clerks
				}
				add = {
					value = 25
					desc = "POP_CLERKS"
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					is_pop_type = soldiers
				}
				add = {
					value = 15
					desc = "POP_SOLDIERS"
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					is_pop_type = peasants
				}
				add = {
					value = 5
					desc = "POP_PEASANTS"
				}
			}
			else = {
				add = {
					value = 10
					desc = "LOWER_NO_ICON"
				}
			}
		}

		if = {
			limit = {
				standard_of_living < state.average_expected_sol
			}
			add = { # Increases likelihood of support if impoverished
				desc = "POP_POVERTY"
				value = state.average_expected_sol
				subtract = standard_of_living
				max = 10
			}
		}

		if = {
			limit = {
				state = {
					state_cultural_acceptance = {
						target = PREV.culture
						value < acceptance_status_5
					}
				}
			}
			add = { # From +2 at 80 to +10 at 0
				desc = "POP_DISCRIMINATED"
				value = 100
				subtract = pop_acceptance
				divide = 10
			}
		}
		else = { # Non-discriminated pops are less likely to form separatist movements
			multiply = {
				desc = "POP_ACCEPTANCE"
				value = 0.25
			}
		}

		multiply = { # Multiplied by 2x max
			desc = "POP_RADICALS"
			value = pop_radical_fraction
			add = 1
		}

		if = {
			limit = {
				owner ?= {
					has_technology_researched = pan-nationalism
				}
			}
			multiply = {
				value = 1.5
				desc = "PAN_NATIONALISM_TECH"
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				owner ?= {
					has_technology_researched = nationalism
				}
			}
			multiply = {
				value = 1.25
				desc = "NATIONALISM_TECH"
			}
		}

		multiply = { # Range from x0.775 to 2.275
			desc = "POP_CULTURE_FERVOR"
			value = culture.culture_current_fervor
			subtract = 15
			multiply = 0.015
			add = 1
		}

		if = { # Funnel people into Indias unique movements
			limit = {
				owner ?= {
					c:BIC ?= this
				}
				culture = { has_discrimination_trait_group = heritage_group_south_asian }
			}
			multiply = 0.5

			if = {
				limit = {
					owner ?= {
						has_technology_researched = pan-nationalism
					}
				}
				multiply = 0.1
			}
		}

		if = {
			limit = {
				owner ?= {
					has_variable = failed_tanzimat
				}
				culture = { has_discrimination_trait_group = heritage_group_european }
			}
			multiply = {
				value = 1.25
				desc = "FAILED_TANZIMAT_REFORMS"
			}
		}

		if = {
			limit = {
				owner ?= {
					has_journal_entry = je_matter_of_hungary
				}
				culture = cu:hungarian
			}
			multiply = {
				value = 1.25
				desc = "je_matter_of_hungary"
			}
		}

		if = {
			limit = {
				culture ?= {
					culture_has_national_awakening = yes
				}
			}
			multiply = {
				value = 1.5
				desc = "POP_ACTIVE_NATIONAL_AWAKENING"
			}
		}

		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					any_scope_diplomatic_pact = {
						is_diplomatic_action_type = support_separatism
						second_country = prev
						"diplomatic_pact_other_country(root.owner)" = {
							country_has_primary_culture = root.culture
						}
					}
				}
			}
			multiply = {
				desc = "SUPPORT_SEPARATISM_ACTION"
				value = support_separatism_total_pop_support
				multiply = 0.01
				add = 1
			}
		}
	}

	secession = {
		can_secede_during_revolution = yes

		possible = {
			owner ?= {
				any_scope_state = {
					state_region = { is_homeland = root.culture }
					culture_percent_state = {
						target = root.culture
						value >= 0.05
					}
				}
			}
		}

		weight = {
			value = 1000
		}

		state_weight = {
			value = 0

			if = {
				limit = {
					is_capital = no
					state_region = { is_homeland = scope:political_movement.culture }
					culture_percent_state = {
						target = scope:political_movement.culture
						value >= 0.05
					}
				}
				add = { # These values must add up to more than 1 - 5 x Obstinance, Turmoil, percent of pops of this culture (counting at most half), and a bonus if this culture is already seceding elsewhere
					value = -1
					add = {
						value = "this.culture_percent_state(scope:political_movement.culture)"
						max = 0.5
					}
					add = this.turmoil
					add = {
						value = this.obstinance
						multiply = 5
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							scope:political_movement = { is_culture_seceding_elsewhere = yes }
						}
						add = 0.5
					}
					multiply = 100
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					is_isolated_from_market = yes
				}
				multiply = 1.5
			}
		}

		interest_group_can_join = {
			trigger_if = {
				limit = {
					c:BIC ?= owner
				}
				is_indian_interest_group = yes
			}
			trigger_else_if = {
				limit = {
					owner = {
						country_is_colonial_or_company = yes
					}
				}
				NOT = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_colonialist
				}
			}
			trigger_else = { # For example - the Austrian Aristocracy can only secede with a Polish uprising if the leader of the IG is Polish
				leader = { culture = scope:political_movement.culture }
			}
		}

		target_fraction_of_states = {
			value = political_movement_identity_support
			add = scope:clout
			multiply = 3
			min = 0.15
			max = 0.75
		}
	}

	additional_radicalism_factors = {
		add = {
			value = "owner.average_sol"
			subtract = "owner.average_sol_for_culture(scope:culture)"
			multiply = 0.05
			max = 0.5
			min = 0
			desc = "STANDARD_OF_LIVING_FOR_CULTURE"
		}

		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					has_law = law_type:law_subjecthood
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 100
				subtract = "owner.country_average_cultural_acceptance(scope:culture)"
				divide = 200 # To get this on the level of the other laws
				subtract = 0.10 # Compensate for religious acceptance, which is currently inaccessible from here
				desc = "DISCRIMINATION_LEVEL_subjecthood"
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = {
				owner = { cultural_acceptance_base = { target = scope:culture value <= acceptance_status_1 } }
			}

			add = {
				value = 0.3
				desc = "DISCRIMINATION_LEVEL_violent_hostility"
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				owner = { cultural_acceptance_base = { target = scope:culture value <= acceptance_status_2 } }
			}

			add = {
				value = 0.2
				desc = "DISCRIMINATION_LEVEL_cultural_erasure"
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				owner = { cultural_acceptance_base = { target = scope:culture value <= acceptance_status_3 } }
			}

			add = {
				value = 0.1
				desc = "DISCRIMINATION_LEVEL_open_prejudice"
			}
		}
		}

		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					any_scope_diplomatic_pact = {
						is_diplomatic_action_type = support_separatism
						second_country = prev
						"diplomatic_pact_other_country(root.owner)" = {
							country_has_primary_culture = root.culture
						}
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				desc = "SUPPORT_SEPARATISM_ACTION"
				value = support_separatism_radicalism
			}
		}

		subtract = {
			value = 0.25
			subtract = political_movement_identity_support
			min = 0
			desc = "LOW_MOVEMENT_IDENTITY_SUPPORT"
		}

		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = { cultural_acceptance_base = { target = scope:culture value <= acceptance_status_4 } }
			}
			add = {
				desc = "FERVOR_OF_CULTURE_ACTIVISM"
				value = scope:culture.culture_current_fervor
				divide = 400
			}
		}

		if = {
			limit = {
				any_in_global_list = { # Victoria 3 Lite: only countries with an insurrection (list refreshed monthly), not every neighbouring state
					variable = vl_insurgent_countries
					is_adjacent_to_country = ROOT.owner
					AND = { AND = {
							NOT = { THIS = ROOT.owner }
							any_political_movement = {
								culture ?= ROOT.culture
								is_insurrectionary = yes
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				desc = "NEIGHBOURING_COUNTRY_WITH_CULTURE_REVOLUTION"
				value = 0.15
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					any_scope_state = {
						state_region = { is_homeland = scope:culture }
						culture_percent_state = {
							target = scope:culture
							value >= 0.05
						}
						is_isolated_from_market = yes
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 0.1
				desc = "ISOLATED_FROM_MARKET"
			}
		}
		add = movement_radicalism_simultaneous_insurrections
		add = movement_radicalism_suppressed_after_civil_war
	}
}

REPLACE:movement_religious_majority = {
	category = movement_category_religious

	ideology = ideology_traditionalist_movement
	character_ideologies = {
		ideology_theocrat
		ideology_traditionalist
	}

	can_cause_obstinance = yes

	creation_trigger = {
		NOT = { has_game_rule = vl_religion_one_faith } # Victoria 3 Lite

		NOT = {
			has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_state_atheism
		}
	}
	creation_weight = {
		value = 100
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner ?= {
					any_political_movement = {
						OR = {
							is_political_movement_type = movement_legitimist
							is_political_movement_type = movement_carlist
							is_political_movement_type = movement_miguelist
						}
					}
				}
			}
			multiply = {
				value = 0.05
			}
		}
	}
	on_created = {}

	disband_trigger = {
		OR = {
			has_game_rule = vl_religion_one_faith # Victoria 3 Lite
			AND = {
		OR = {
			scope:political_movement ?= {
				religion = {
					NOT = { is_state_religion = root }
				}
			}
			has_council_republic_law = yes
		}
				}
		}
	}
	on_disbanded = {
		fold_movement_into_anti_communist_movement_effect = yes
	}

	religion_selection_trigger = {
		is_state_religion = scope:country
	}
	religion_selection_weight = {
		value = 100
	}

	character_support_trigger = {
		religion = scope:religion
		OR = {
			is_interest_group_type = ig_devout
			has_ideology = ideology:ideology_traditionalist
			has_ideology = ideology:ideology_theocrat
			has_ideology = ideology:ideology_integralist
		}
	}
	character_support_weight = {
		value = 100
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:interest_group ?= {
					is_interest_group_type = ig_devout
				}
			}
			multiply = {
				value = 2
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_traditionalist
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_theocrat
				}
			}
			multiply = {
				value = 5
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				has_ideology = ideology:ideology_integralist
			}
			multiply = {
				value = 2
			}
		}
	}

	pop_support_trigger = {
		religion = scope:religion
	}

	pop_support_factors = {
		movement_support_low_urbanization
		movement_support_low_literacy
		movement_support_clergymen
		movement_support_aristocrats
		movement_support_peasants
		movement_support_corporatism_tech
	}

	pop_support_weight = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:political_movement
				scope:political_movement ?= {
					OR = {
						is_being_suppressed = yes
						is_being_bolstered = yes
					}
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					scope:political_movement = {
						is_being_suppressed = yes
					}
				}
				add = {
					value = suppression_base_value
					multiply = {
						value = -0.5
						add = owner.modifier:country_suppression_attraction_factor
					}
					desc = "concept_suppressed"
				}
			}
			else = {
				add = {
					value = bolstering_base_value
					multiply = {
						value = 0.5
						add = owner.modifier:country_bolster_attraction_factor
					}
					desc = "concept_bolstered"
				}
			}
		}

		add = {
			desc = "URBAN_STATE" # Increases support in rural states, decreases in urban
			value = 0.5
			subtract = state.state_urbanization_rate
			multiply = 10
		}

		add = {
			value = 10
			desc = "POP_BASE_SUPPORT"
		}

		if = {
			limit = {
				is_pop_type = clergymen
			}
			add = {
				value = 45
				desc = "POP_CLERGYMEN"
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				is_pop_type = aristocrats
			}
			add = {
				value = 15
				desc = "POP_ARISTOCRATS"
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				is_pop_type = peasants
			}
			add = {
				value = 10
				desc = "POP_PEASANTS"
			}
		}

		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					is_pop_type = clergymen
				}
			}
			add = { # Weakened by increasing literacy rates
				desc = "POP_LITERACY"
				this = {
					value = literacy_rate
					multiply = -2
				}
			}
		}

		if = { # Discriminated pops are less inclined to support the state church
			limit = {
				pop_acceptance < acceptance_status_5
			}
			multiply = {
				desc = "POP_ACCEPTANCE"
				value = pop_acceptance
				divide = 100
				add = 0.25
			}
		}

		if = {
			limit = {
				owner ?= {
					has_technology_researched = corporatism
				}
			}
			multiply = {
				value = 1.5
				desc = "CORPORATISM_TECH"
			}
		}

		if = {
			limit = {
				owner ?= {
					any_political_movement = {
						OR = {
							is_political_movement_type = movement_legitimist
							is_political_movement_type = movement_carlist
							is_political_movement_type = movement_miguelist
						}
					}
				}
			}
			multiply = {
				value = 0.05
			}
		}
	}

	revolution = {
		weight = {
			value = 100
		}

		interest_group_can_join = {
			leader = { religion = scope:political_movement.religion }
		}

		state_weight = {
			value = 1

			if = {
				limit = {
					religion_percent_state = {
						target = scope:political_movement.religion
						value >= 0.75
					}
				}
				add = 75
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					religion_percent_state = {
						target = scope:political_movement.religion
						value >= 0.5
					}
				}
				add = 50
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					religion_percent_state = {
						target = scope:political_movement.religion
						value >= 0.25
					}
				}
				add = 25
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					religion_percent_state = {
						target = scope:political_movement.religion
						value >= 0.1
					}
				}
				add = 10
			}
		}
	}

	secession = {
		can_secede_during_revolution = yes

		possible = {
			political_movement_support >= 0.05
			scope:clout <= 0
		}

		weight = {
			value = 1000
		}

		interest_group_can_join = {
			leader = { religion = scope:political_movement.religion }
		}

		state_weight = {
			value = 0

			if = {
				limit = {
					religion_percent_state = {
						target = scope:political_movement.religion
						value >= 0.75
					}
				}
				add = 250
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					religion_percent_state = {
						target = scope:political_movement.religion
						value >= 0.5
					}
				}
				add = 150
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					religion_percent_state = {
						target = scope:political_movement.religion
						value >= 0.25
					}
				}
				add = 50
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					religion_percent_state = {
						target = scope:political_movement.religion
						value >= 0.1
					}
				}
				add = 10
			}
		}
	}

	additional_radicalism_factors = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner.ruler ?= {
					NOT = { religion = root.religion }
				}
			}

			add = {
				value = 0.1
				desc = "RULER_WRONG_RELIGION"
			}
		}

		add = {
			value = "owner.average_sol"
			subtract = "owner.average_sol_for_religion(scope:religion)"
			multiply = 0.05
			max = 0.5
			min = 0
			desc = "STANDARD_OF_LIVING_FOR_RELIGION"
		}

		if = {
			limit = {
				religion = rel:catholic
			}
			add = movement_radicalism_poor_papal_relations
		}

		add = movement_radicalism_neighboring_religious_revolution
		add = movement_radicalism_suppressed_after_civil_war
	}
}

REPLACE:movement_pro_slavery = {
	category = movement_category_ideological

	ideology = ideology_pro_slavery_movement
	character_ideologies = {
		ideology_slaver
		ideology_jacksonian_democrat
	}

	creation_trigger = {
		NOT = { has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_slavery_banned }
	}
	creation_weight = {
		value = 100
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner ?= { # If a movement of this type exists in a neighbouring country, make it more likely to spawn here as well
					any_neighbouring_state = {
						owner = {
							prestige > ROOT.owner.prestige
							any_political_movement = {
								is_political_movement_type = movement_pro_slavery
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
			multiply = {
				value = 2
			}
		}
	}
	on_created = {
		add_movement_enthusiasm_modifier = yes
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_colonial_slavery
				}
			}
			set_core_ideology = ideology_pro_slavery_colonial_movement
		}
	}

	character_support_trigger = {
		trigger_if = {
			limit = {
				is_in_exile_pool = yes
			}
			OR = {
				has_ideology = ideology:ideology_slaver
				has_ideology = ideology:ideology_jacksonian_democrat
			}
		}
		trigger_else = {
			OR = {
				has_ideology = ideology:ideology_slaver
				has_ideology = ideology:ideology_jacksonian_democrat
				scope:interest_group ?= {
					OR = {
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_pro_slavery
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_pro_slavery_colonial
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	character_support_weight = {
		value = 200
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_ideology = ideology:ideology_slaver
			}
			multiply = {
				value = 5
			}
		}
	}

	pop_support_trigger = {
		state = { is_slave_state = yes }
	}

	pop_support_factors = {
		movement_support_slave_state
		movement_support_high_literacy
		movement_support_aristocrats
		movement_support_farmers
		movement_support_clergymen
		movement_support_officers
		movement_support_clergymen
		movement_support_je_acw_countdown
	}

	pop_support_weight = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:political_movement
				scope:political_movement ?= {
						OR = {
							is_being_suppressed = yes
							is_being_bolstered = yes
						}
					}
				}
			if = {
				limit = {
					scope:political_movement = {
						is_being_suppressed = yes
					}
				}
				add = {
					value = suppression_base_value
					multiply = {
						value = -0.5
						add = owner.modifier:country_suppression_attraction_factor
					}
					desc = "concept_suppressed"
				}
			}
			else = {
				add = {
					value = bolstering_base_value
					multiply = {
						value = 0.5
						add = owner.modifier:country_bolster_attraction_factor
					}
					desc = "concept_bolstered"
				}
			}
		}
		add = {
			value = 9
			desc = "SLAVE_STATE"
		}

		if = {
			limit = {
				is_pop_type = aristocrats
			}
			add = {
				value = 45
				desc = "POP_ARISTOCRATS"
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				is_pop_type = farmers
			}
			add = {
				value = 15
				desc = "POP_FARMERS"
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				is_pop_type = clergymen
			}
			add = {
				value = 15
				desc = "POP_CLERGYMEN"
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				is_pop_type = officers
			}
			add = {
				value = 15
				desc = "POP_OFFICERS"
			}
		}

		if = {
			limit = {
				owner ?= { has_journal_entry = je_acw_countdown }
			}

			multiply = {
				value = 3.0
				desc = "je_acw_countdown"
			}
		}

		multiply = { # Illiterate pops participate at 1/10 the rate of fully literate pops
			desc = "POP_LITERACY"
			value = literacy_rate
			add = 0.10
		}
	}

	revolution = {
		possible = {
			political_movement_support >= 0.05
		}

		weight = {
			value = 100
		}

		state_weight = {
			value = 1
			add = scope:clout
			if = {
			   limit = {
					is_slave_state = no
					NOT = { has_variable = former_slave_state }
				}
			    if = {
					limit = {
						owner ?= {
							OR = {
								has_journal_entry = je_acw_countdown
								OR = {
									has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_legacy_slavery
									has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_colonial_slavery
								}
								has_variable = slavery_recently_abolished
							}
							any_scope_state = {
								OR = {
								   is_slave_state = yes
								   has_variable = former_slave_state
								}
							}
						}
					}
					multiply = 0.0
				}
				else = {
					multiply = 0.25
				}
			}

			if = {
				limit = { is_capital = yes }
				if = {
					limit = { owner ?= { NOT = { has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_slavery_banned } } }
					multiply = 10.0
				}
				else = {
					multiply = 0.1
				}
			}
		}
	}

	secession = {
		possible = {
			political_movement_support >= 0.05
			OR = {
				scope:clout <= 0
				owner = {
					OR = {
						has_journal_entry = je_acw_countdown
						OR = {
							has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_legacy_slavery
							has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_colonial_slavery
						}
						has_variable = slavery_recently_abolished
					}
				}
			}
		}

		weight = {
			value = 10

			if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						owner ?= {
							OR = {
								has_journal_entry = je_acw_countdown
								has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_colonial_slavery
								has_variable = slavery_recently_abolished
							}
						}
						scope:clout <= 0
					}
				}
				add = 1000
			}
		}

		forced_tags = {
			CSA = {
				trigger = {
					owner ?= { has_journal_entry = je_acw_countdown }
				}
				weight = 1000
			}
		}

		state_weight = {
			value = 1
			add = scope:clout
			if = {
			   limit = {
					is_slave_state = no
					NOT = { has_variable = former_slave_state }
			   }
			   if = {
					limit = {
						owner ?= {
							OR = {
								has_journal_entry = je_acw_countdown
								OR = {
									has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_legacy_slavery
									has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_colonial_slavery
								}
								has_variable = slavery_recently_abolished
							}
							any_scope_state = {
								OR = {
								   is_slave_state = yes
								   has_variable = former_slave_state
								}
							}
						}
					}
					multiply = 0.0
				}
				else = {
					multiply = 0.25
				}
			}

			if = {
				limit = {
					owner ?= { has_journal_entry = je_acw_countdown }
				}

				if = { # Ensure the union retains Washington DC/Maryland/Delaware in case of southern secession
					limit = {
						OR = {
							state_region = s:STATE_MARYLAND
							state_region = s:STATE_DELAWARE
							state_region = s:STATE_DISTRICT_OF_COLUMBIA
							state_region = s:STATE_WEST_VIRGINIA
						}
					}

					multiply = 0.0
				}
				else_if = { # Virginia should be CSA capital
					limit = {
						state_region = s:STATE_VIRGINIA
					}

					multiply = 10.0
				}
			}
		}
	}

	additional_radicalism_factors = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner.ruler ?= {
					OR = {
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_abolitionist
						AND = {
							NOR = {
								has_ideology = ideology:ideology_slaver
								has_ideology = ideology:ideology_jacksonian_democrat
							}
							interest_group ?= { has_ideology = ideology:ideology_anti_slavery }
						}
					}
				}
			}

			add = {
				value = 0.1
				desc = "RULER_IS_ANTI_SLAVERY"
			}
		}

		if = {
			limit = {
				owner.army_size > 0
				owner = {
					NOR = {
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_slavery_banned
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_colonial_slavery
					}
				}
			}

			add = {
				owner = {
					every_scope_state = { # Victoria 3 Lite: states, not every building
						limit = { is_slave_state = yes has_building = building_barrack }
						add = b:building_barrack.level
					}
				}

				divide = {
					value = owner.army_size
					min = 1
				}

				subtract = 0.5
				multiply = -1
				min = 0
				max = 0.5
				desc = "ARMY_FRACTION_IN_SLAVE_STATES"
			}
		}

		if = {
			limit = {
				owner.navy_size > 0
				owner = {
					NOR = {
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_slavery_banned
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_colonial_slavery
					}
				}
			}

			add = {
				owner = {
					every_scope_state = { # Victoria 3 Lite: states, not every building
						limit = { is_slave_state = yes has_building = building_naval_administration }
						add = b:building_naval_administration.level
					}
				}

				divide = {
					value = owner.navy_size
					min = 1
				}

				subtract = 0.5
				multiply = -0.5
				min = 0
				max = 0.25
				desc = "NAVY_FRACTION_IN_SLAVE_STATES"
			}
		}

		add = movement_radicalism_acw_countdown

		if = {
			limit = {
				neighboring_country_has_insurrectionary_movement_trigger = { TYPE = movement_pro_slavery }
			}
			add = {
				desc = "NEIGHBOURING_COUNTRY_WITH_REVOLUTION"
				value = 0.15
			}
		}
		add = movement_radicalism_suppressed_after_civil_war
	}
}
